svg.title: Downstream evidence contexts with exact source citations
svg.desc: A downstream request retrieves authorized context, reconstructs canonical items and provenance, produces exact source citations and warnings, and stores a context-only answer with no graph mutation capability. It does not generate a free-form language-model answer.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p:
Search, QA, or agent request
mode + filters + budget

div.style: color: rgb(107, 73, 24) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Component starts with
downstream?

div.style: color: rgb(130, 63, 57) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Reject request
RETRIEVAL_ROLE

div.style: color: rgb(32, 63, 104) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
HybridRetriever.retrieve
snapshot + ACL + budget checks

div.style: color: rgb(65, 71, 121) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Load retrieval result
and selected graph context

div.style: color: rgb(100, 62, 122) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Validate query, graph version
scope + retrieval fingerprint

div.style: color: rgb(100, 62, 122) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Reconstruct canonical items
with current application ACL

div.style: color: rgb(65, 71, 121) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Trace matching committed proof
plan · transaction · resolution
observation · evidence · source

div.style: color: rgb(100, 62, 122) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Check projections + unique IDs
conservative context budgets

div.style: color: rgb(32, 63, 104) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Cite every selected evidence span
source ID + hash + offsets + quote

div.style: color: rgb(130, 63, 57) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Fail context validation
no answer context returned

div.style: color: rgb(32, 63, 104) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Preserve retrieval warnings
add conflicts, incomplete proof,
or no authorized context

div.style: color: rgb(65, 71, 121) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Construct graphrag-answer
answer_status = CONTEXT_ONLY
can_mutate_graph = false

div.style: color: rgb(65, 71, 121) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Store immutable answer record
query + result + context IDs

div.style: color: rgb(65, 71, 121) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Return answer_context_id
and structured context body

div.style: color: rgb(83, 98, 119) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Caller consumes cited context
any further answer generation
is outside this service
